newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Kabila arrives for inauguration, students warned.
newsitem.headline: Kabila arrives for inauguration, students warned.

text.p: Self-proclaimed president Laurent Kabila arrived at Kinshasa's main sports stadium on Thursday for his inauguration as head of state of the Democratic Republic of Congo, the former Zaire.

The presidents of Uganda, Rwanda, Angola, Burundi and Zambia arrived before him for the ceremony, which caps seven-months of civil war during which Kabila and his forces drove veteran dictator Mobutu Sese Seko from power.

Earlier, organisers publicly warned hundreds of students calling for democracy and payment of grants that any further disruption of the ceremony would provoke a "firm" response and they alone would bear responsibilty for the consequences.

Tens of thousands of Kinshasa residents turned out for their first real-life glimpse of Kabila, who has kept out of the public eye since arriving in the city on May 20, three days after his forces marched into Kinshasa.
